summary: Every public page now ships complete search and social previews in the first HTML response: Open Graph and X cards, JSON-LD, sitemaps, and staff controls for site-wide and per-post SEO.
detailed_changes: Article and page HTML includes og:type article, article timing and authorship tags, og:image width/height/alt, twitter:card summary_large_image, og:site_name and og:locale en_GB, matching the React Head output for crawlers (#667).

Automatic meta titles (max 60 characters plus “ | APES Newsroom”) and descriptions (max 155 characters from the excerpt or first body paragraph) generate live in the staff editor; clearing an override restores the automatic value (#668).

Admin → Settings gains an SEO section for the default description, share image, X handle, social profile URLs, Google/Bing verification, default noindex for tag/author archives, and an editable robots.txt (audit-logged) (#670).
Staff post and page editors gain a full SEO and social panel: meta title/description, canonical, noindex, Open Graph and X overrides, character counters, and Google/social preview cards (#669).
Server HTML embeds NewsArticle, Organization, WebSite with SearchAction, and BreadcrumbList JSON-LD (#671).

Sitemap index at /sitemap.xml with posts, pages, channels, tags and a Google News sitemap for the last 48 hours; noindex posts and pages are excluded; /robots.txt is admin-managed and always includes the Sitemap line (#672).
Canonical URLs drop trailing slashes and tracking query noise; search, account and preview pages send noindex; hreflang en-GB is emitted (#673).
Social cards use the 1200×630 hero crop when available, otherwise a branded fallback under 1 MB with alt text (#674).
Feature and unit tests cover meta HTML snapshots, MetaGenerator, sitemaps, robots and canonical hygiene without network calls (#675).
affected_areas: Page or route: public pages, /sitemap*.xml, /robots.txt, Admin → Settings, staff post/page editors
User groups affected: readers (richer previews when sharing), staff editors, admins
Public impact: improved search listings and social share cards
Internal impact: Admin SEO settings and per-post SEO panel
